environment.description: Same FastAPI service on identical EKS cluster. Pod spec includes a custom seccomp profile loaded via RuntimeDefault+LocalhostProfile at path '/var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/webhook-hardened.json'. The profile is based on runtime/default but additionally denies the 'connect' syscall (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO) for AF_INET/AF_INET6 socket families targeting destination addresses in RFC 1918 ranges and link-local (169.254.0.0/16) via a BPF-backed seccomp-notify filter delegating to a userspace agent (seccomp-agent v0.4.2) that inspects sockaddr_in structs before permitting connect(). The agent configuration allowlists only connections to the pod's own service mesh sidecar (127.0.0.6:15001) and external IPs resolved through the mesh's egress gateway (istio-egressgateway on 10.96.45.12:443). Direct connect() to 169.254.169.254 or any link-local address returns EACCES. Additionally, the node's iptables PREROUTING chain has a rule dropping packets from pod CIDR to 169.254.169.254:80 as defense-in-depth.

config.connect_filter: SCMP_ACT_NOTIFY on connect() -> userspace validation of dst_addr
